control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: regulator directive concerning energy isolation at PSV-8202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-8202 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-8202 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-8202 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 24 January 2019 a regulatory notice was issued concerning PSV-8202 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station following transfer operations.
